description.en: The ID of the access configuration.
The ID of the task object.

description.zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。
description.en: The type of the task object. Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory.

title.zh: 解除访问配置在RD账号上的部署

descriptions.zh:
该API的操作为异步操作。您可以使用返回参数中的`TaskId`，调用[GetTask](~~340670~~)查询任务执行状态。

本文将提供一个示例，解除访问配置`ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`在RD账号`114240524784****`上的部署。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, an asynchronous task is automatically created. You can call the [GetTask](~~340670~~) operation to query the progress of the task based on the value of the `TaskId` response parameter.

This topic provides an example on how to de-provision the access configuration `ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****` from the account `114240524784****` in your resource directory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso deprovision-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --region cn-hangzhou
